d: A machine is a piece of equipment with moving parts that uses power to do a specific job.
If you are mad, you are very angry and annoyed about something.
A magazine is a thin book with articles and photos that is published every week or month.
Magic is the power to make impossible things happen using mysterious forces.
A magnet is a piece of heavy metal that pulls other metal objects toward it.
If something is magnetic, it has a strong power to pull metal things toward itself.
If something is magnificent, it is extremely beautiful, grand, and impressive.
Mail is the letters and packages that are delivered to your home or office.
The main thing is the largest, most important, or most frequently used thing in a group.
You use mainly to say that something is generally true for the most part.
If you maintain something, you continue to keep it in a good working condition.
Maintenance is the work of keeping a building or machine in good repair.
If an issue is major, it is very large, important, or serious.
The majority of a group of people or things is more than half of them.
If you make something, you create or build it by putting parts or materials together.
A maker is a person or company that creates or produces specific products.
Makeup consists of colored substances like lipstick and powder that people put on their faces to look attractive.
Male means belonging to the sex that cannot have babies or lay eggs.
A mall is a very large enclosed building containing many different stores and restaurants.
A man is a fully grown adult male human being.
If you manage a business, you are in charge of controlling and organizing it.
Management is the control and organization of a large business or company.
A manager is a person whose job is to control the staff and operations of a business.
A margin is the empty white space at the side of a printed page.
A mark is a spot, stain, or line on a surface that damages its clean appearance.
A market is a public place where people gather to buy and sell fresh food and goods.
Marketing is the business strategy of deciding how to advertise and sell a product.
Marriage is the legal relationship between two people who are officially joined together.
If you are married, you have a husband or a wife.
If you marry someone, you become their legally recognized husband or wife.
If something is marvelous, it is extremely good, wonderful, and surprising.
A mask is a covering that you wear over your face to protect it or to hide your identity.
A mass is a large amount of something that has no clear shape or form.
If an object is massive, it is incredibly large, heavy, and solid.
A master is someone who is incredibly skilled at a particular activity or art.
A match is an organized sports competition played between two teams or players.
A mate is an informal word used to describe a friend or a partner.
A material is any physical substance like wood, plastic, or cloth that you use to make things.
Math is the science of working with numbers, shapes, and amounts.
Mathematics is the formal, academic study of numbers, quantities, and shapes.
A matter is a situation or subject that you need to think about or discuss.
The maximum amount is the absolute largest possible amount allowed.
You use may to say that a future event is possible, but not completely certain.
You use maybe to indicate that a fact is possible but you are not entirely sure.
A mayor is the elected leader of a town or a city government.
A meal is the food that you eat at a specific time of day, like breakfast or dinner.
If a word means something, it represents that specific idea or object.
The meaning of a word is the exact idea that the word represents.
You use meanwhile to describe something happening at the exact same time as another event.
If you measure something, you use a tool to find its exact size, length, or weight.
A measurement is the exact size or length of something, discovered by measuring it.
Meat is the flesh of an animal that is cooked and eaten as food.
A mechanic is a professional whose job is repairing the engines of cars and machines.
Mechanical means relating to the physical moving parts of machines or engines.
A mechanism is a system of moving parts inside a machine that performs a function.
The media refers to television, radio, and newspapers that provide news to the public.
Medical means relating to the treatment of illness and injuries by doctors.
Medicine is a drug or chemical that you take to cure an illness or pain.
If something is medium, it is right in the middle between large and small.
When you meet someone, you happen to be in the same place as them and start talking.
A meeting is an event where people gather together to officially discuss a business topic.
If a solid melts, it becomes a hot liquid because it has been heated.
A member is a person who belongs to a particular group, club, or team.
Membership is the official fact or state of being a member of a club.
Your memory is your brain's ability to remember past events and information.
Mental means relating to the mind and the process of thinking.
If a problem affects you mentally, it exists inside your mind or thoughts.
If you mention something, you say a few words about it in a conversation.
A menu is a printed list of all the different foods you can order in a restaurant.
You use mere to emphasize how small, weak, or unimportant something is.
You use merely to emphasize that you mean exactly what you say and absolutely nothing more.
A mess is a very dirty, untidy state where things are left everywhere in confusion.
A message is a piece of written or spoken information you send to another person.
Metal is a hard, shiny solid material like iron or gold that carries heat and electricity.
A meter is a measurement of length equal to one hundred centimeters.
A method is a specific, planned way of doing something to achieve a result.
The middle of an object or space is the exact center point of it.
Midnight is twelve o'clock at night, when one day ends and another begins.
You use might to say that something is a possibility but you are not totally certain.
If the weather is mild, it is pleasantly warm and not severely cold.
The military is the official armed forces of a country, including the army and navy.
Milk is the white liquid produced by cows or goats that humans drink.
A mill is a building where grain is crushed into flour, or a factory producing goods.
A million is the number 1,000,000.
Your mind is your brain and your ability to think, feel, and remember things.
A mine is a deep hole in the ground where workers dig out coal, gold, or diamonds.
A mineral is a natural substance like iron or salt that forms under the earth.
The minimum amount is the absolutely smallest amount allowed or possible.
A minister is a political leader in charge of a specific government department.
If a problem is minor, it is very small and not highly important.
A minority is a smaller group within a larger group that is different in race or belief.
A miracle is a wonderful, highly surprising event that cannot be explained by science.
A mirror is a flat piece of smooth glass that clearly reflects your image back at you.
If you miss something, you fail to hit it, catch it, or attend it.
A mission is a very important task or job that someone is sent away to do.
A mistake is something that you do wrong by accident.
A minute is a period of time equal to exactly sixty seconds.
If something is minute, it is incredibly tiny in size or amount.
If something is moderate, it is neither very large nor very small, but perfectly in the middle.
If you moderate a debate, you act as the leader to ensure everyone speaks fairly.
